description: A web application for small businesses and freelancers to create, manage, and track invoices with client management, line‑item detail, and payment status, plus PDF generation.
core_features: Create, edit, and delete client records
Create invoices with multiple line items
Automatic calculation of totals and tax
Track payment status (Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue)
Generate and download PDF versions of invoices
future_features: Support recurring invoices and subscription billing
Dashboard analytics for revenue and outstanding balances

milestones: Define SQLite schema and SQLAlchemy models
Implement invoice and line‑item CRUD API endpoints
Build React pages for client and invoice management
Add payment status workflow (Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue)
Integrate status updates into invoice UI
Improve PDF layout and add download button
Implement basic authentication and role handling
Create analytics dashboard for revenue and outstanding balances
